definition.en: A line pressed or half-cut into card so it folds cleanly and exactly where intended. Heavy stock cracks when folded unscored; a scored fold is also weaker, which the engine models as a lower hinge stiffness.
definition.es: Una línea presionada o semicortada en la cartulina para que doble limpia y exactamente donde se quiere. El papel grueso se agrieta si se dobla sin hendir; un pliegue hendido además es más débil, y el motor lo modela con una rigidez de bisagra menor.
definition.fr: Une ligne pressée ou entaillée à mi-épaisseur dans le carton pour qu'il se plie net, exactement où l'on veut. Un papier épais se fissure s'il est plié sans rainage ; un pli rainé est aussi plus souple, ce que le moteur modélise par une raideur de charnière plus faible.
definition.pt: Uma linha prensada ou meio cortada na cartolina para que dobre de forma limpa e exatamente onde se pretende. O papel grosso estala se for dobrado sem vinco; uma dobra vincada é também mais fraca, o que o motor modela com uma rigidez de dobradiça menor.

aliases.name: score
aliases.note: pliego:edges_treatment value; the exporters emit it as a separate pass (blade or laser at reduced power) before the cut.

constraints: A score admits only M, V or F assignments, and the score pass is exported BEFORE the cut pass: cutting first frees the piece and the score lands in the wrong place.
sources: Pliego docs/spec/v1/sheet-document.md (sheet document v1) §4 — edge treatment
Pliego docs/spec/v1/stock-card.md — scoring recommended above 160 g/m²
